buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BHARAT PETROLEUM CORPORATION LIMITED LPG Bottling Plant Piyala Scope of Work Professional Facilitation and Programme Services for LPG Operations and S ales Meet The contractor shall provide professional facilitation and programme services for the one-day LPG Operations and Sales Meet. The scope includes two team-building sessi ons, programme anchoring, agenda design, digital workshop content, activity consu mables and a consolidated proceedings and action report. 1 Event duration and planning The programme shall be conducted within one event day. The event date, venue and timings shall be confirmed by the BPCL Officer-in-Charge. Pre-event preparation and

post-event reporting form part of the respective job items and shall be completed to the schedule agreed with BPCL. Consult BPCL before the event to understand the meeting objectives, participant prof ile and operational and sales discussion themes. Submit the proposed agenda, sessio n objectives, activity plan, personnel details and deliverable schedule for approval be fore execution. 2 Schedule of services S No Description Qty Unit 1 Team-building session delivery 2 Sessions 2 Programme anchor 1 Day 3 Agenda and session design 1 Job 4 Workshop content preparation 1 Job 5 Team exercise consumables 20 Kits 6 Proceedings and action report 1 Job 3 Team building session delivery Conduct minimum two professional instructor-led team-building sessions within the s ame event. Agree the duration and sequence of each session with BPCL as part of th e approved agenda. Use participative exercises suited to communication, coordinatio n, problem-solving and teamwork in the context of LPG operations and sales. Provide competent facilitators to explain the activities, organise teams, supervise par ticipation, manage time and conduct a debrief after each exercise. Link the discussio n to practical workplace actions and capture the key learning points. Activities shall b e appropriate to the venue and participant capabilities. Stage, audio system and ven ue arrangements are excluded from this item. 4 Programme anchor Deploy one professional anchor for the event day to manage introductions, session tr ansitions, announcements and timekeeping. The anchor shall review the approved a genda with BPCL beforehand, verify names and designations, and coordinate with sp eakers and facilitators. Follow BPCL instructions on protocol and programme changes . 5 Agenda and session design Prepare a detailed agenda after pre-event consultation with BPCL, showing session s equence, objectives, proposed timings, speaker or facilitator responsibilities and tran sitions. Integrate both team-building sessions with the operational and sales discussi ons. Submit the agenda for approval and incorporate BPCL comments before issuing the final programme.

6 Workshop content preparation Prepare digital case studies, discussion slides and action templates aligned with the a pproved objectives. Use BPCL inputs for organisation-specific facts and obtain approv al before use. Include clear instructions for group work, discussion prompts and temp lates for recording learning points and proposed actions. Submit the final digital files i n commonly accessible formats and editable source formats where applicable. Printin g and presentation equipment are excluded. 7 Team exercise consumables Provide activity kits containing the activity cards and task materials required for the approved team exercises. Submit the proposed contents for BPCL approval before pr ocurement. Deliver and check all kits before the first session, and replace incomplete or defective materials promptly. Include the quantities necessary to carry out the app roved exercises without charging the same materials under another item. 8 Proceedings and action report Provide rapporteur services during the programme to record the principal discussion points, session outcomes, decisions and agreed actions. Prepare one consolidated di gital report with minutes, key learning points and an action tracker. The tracker shall identify each action, the responsible person or function and target date where agree d; unresolved details shall be marked for confirmation rather than assumed. Submit the draft report to BPCL within the mutually agreed reporting schedule, incor porate review comments and deliver the final report with the action tracker in editabl e digital formats. Provide a PDF copy of the final report for circulation. All report prep aration and revisions required to reflect the approved proceedings shall be included i n this job item. 9 Coordination confidentiality and safety Nominate one coordinator for pre-event planning, event-day execution and final repo rting. Coordinate equipment interfaces and venue access with BPCL and the separate ly engaged agencies. Arrange a briefing before commencement to verify agenda rea diness, content availability and activity materials. Promptly rectify any deficiency in t he included services. Use safe activities and suitable materials; avoid exercises involving hazardous substa nces, open flames or unsafe physical exertion. Follow BPCL and venue instructions an d keep access routes clear. Treat participant information, BPCL data, presentations a nd proceedings as confidential. Do not publish, share or reuse them for publicity with out BPCL permission. 10 Completion and acceptance Acceptance shall be based on BPCL approval of the agenda and digital content, deliv ery of both facilitated sessions and event-day anchoring, supply of 20 complete activi ty kits, and receipt of the final proceedings and action report. 11 Scope boundaries and price coverage Venue hire, stage or platform, audiovisual equipment, event lighting, backdrop and si gnage, photography, catering and ordinary stationery are outside this package. The quoted prices shall include professional fees, preparation, personnel, travel, transpor

t, activity consumables and reporting necessary for the stated scope. Quote taxes as required in the GeM bid. Any variation requires prior written BPCL approval. Payment and other commercial conditions shall follow the GeM bid and applicable BPCL tender documents. . 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.
